title: Add a list-candidates command to the distillation CLI
description: Add a new 'list-candidates' subcommand to distill/cli.py that lists locally staged training candidates. It must accept an optional --candidate-root argument (type Path, default distill/models/candidates, matching the existing train/deploy subcommands' default pattern). For each immediate subdirectory of the candidate root that contains a candidate-manifest.json file, print one line in the form '<directory-name>: <model_id>@<model_revision>' (reading model_id and model_revision from that manifest JSON). Sort output lines alphabetically by directory name. If the candidate root does not exist or contains no such subdirectories, print exactly 'No candidates found.' and nothing else. Do not change the behavior of any existing command. Add unit tests in tests/test_distill_cli.py covering: (1) multiple candidates print sorted one-per-line in the documented format, (2) a missing or empty candidate root prints 'No candidates found.', (3) a subdirectory without a candidate-manifest.json is skipped rather than causing an error.
acceptance_criteria: distill/cli.py defines a new 'list-candidates' subcommand with a --candidate-root option (type Path, default distill/models/candidates).
Output lines are sorted alphabetically by candidate directory name, in the format '<directory-name>: <model_id>@<model_revision>'.
An empty or missing candidate root prints exactly 'No candidates found.'
Subdirectories without a candidate-manifest.json file are silently skipped, not treated as errors.
New unit tests exist in tests/test_distill_cli.py covering the three scenarios described above.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_distill_cli.py -q successfully.
Run python -m pytest -q successfully with no failing tests.
No unrelated files are modified.

title: Add an optional glob pattern filter to Workspace.list_files
description: Add an optional pattern keyword argument (str | None, default None) to Workspace.list_files in tools/workspace.py. When pattern is None, behavior must be unchanged. When pattern is provided (for example '*.py'), only files whose name matches the glob pattern (via Path.match or fnmatch on the file name) are included in the returned sorted list; directory traversal and path-safety checks must remain exactly as before. Add unit tests in tests/test_workspace.py covering: (1) pattern=None preserves the existing unfiltered behavior, (2) a pattern such as '*.md' returns only matching files from a mixed-extension directory, (3) a pattern matching nothing returns an empty list rather than an error.
acceptance_criteria: tools/workspace.py's Workspace.list_files accepts an optional pattern keyword argument that filters results by filename glob match when provided.
Omitting pattern (or passing None) preserves the current unfiltered behavior exactly.
Existing path-safety and traversal checks in Workspace.list_files are unchanged.
New unit tests exist in tests/test_workspace.py covering the three scenarios described above.

title: Add a failure_summary property to VerificationResult
description: Add a read-only failure_summary property to the VerificationResult model in agent/models.py. When passed is True (and failures is therefore empty), it must return exactly 'All verification commands passed.'. When passed is False, it must return a string starting with the failure count followed by ' verification failure(s): ' and then the failures joined with '; ', in their existing list order (for example '2 verification failure(s): first failure; second failure'). Add unit tests in tests/test_models.py covering: (1) a passing VerificationResult returns the fixed success message, (2) a failing VerificationResult with multiple failures returns the correctly formatted and ordered summary.
acceptance_criteria: agent/models.py defines VerificationResult.failure_summary as a property producing the exact formats described above.
New unit tests exist in tests/test_models.py covering the passing and multi-failure scenarios.
